decisions.reason: The broader express line D was withdrawn, so the 15-day program is now the firm's remaining standard express offer and sits close to the core, but it is only mentioned on the website and its results may fall short of aspiration, so further consolidation is possible.

The 72-hour service supports the fast-response promise, but it is costly to keep up in practice and has low visibility after D's withdrawal, so a shortfall could trigger problemistic search, although slack in a large, growing firm still allows it to be carried for now.
The European-certified fire-resistant exterior door extends the core modular fire-protection system and likely meets aspirations, so there is no reason to search for other uses of its resources.

The digital ordering and services platform matches the firm's strategic move toward service and advisory support, and organisational slack allows it to be carried while its returns are still uncertain.
The fire and smoke protection door is a compliance-driven core product with steady demand in building projects and is unlikely to fall below aspirations.
